lines.en: label wakanadate25p2:
scene noonsky
My coworker or friend or whatever she’s supposed to be shows up not long after I step outside and I notice that she’s completely empty-handed.
lines.zh: 我走出店门没多久，我那位同事／朋友／管她算什么的人也出来了，我注意到她两手空空。

lines.en: So either she’s given up on pursuing something she thought was important just moments ago or my inability to help her forced her out of the shop without so much as a free bookmark.
lines.zh: 所以要么是她放弃了片刻前还认为重要的追求，要么是我的不配合逼得她连一张免费书签都没拿就出了店。

lines.en: Either way, I manage to come out on top this time — which mirrors the exact position I always end up taking in my fantasies of her.
lines.zh: 不管怎样，这次我算是占了上风——这恰好跟我在对她的幻想里最后总采取的体位一致。

lines.en: I wouldn’t be surprised if those stopped for a little while now.
lines.zh: 要是那些幻想消停一阵子，我不会意外。

lines.en: There’s a right time and a wrong time to pressure people into revealing their troubles to you, and I like to believe I’m a lot better when it comes to eying the clock than Wakana is.
lines.zh: 逼人把烦恼说给你听，是有对的时候和错的时候的，而我愿意相信我比 Wakana 更会看表。

lines.en: That could very well just be something {i}I{/i} believe though. When, in all actuality, I may have been on the exact opposite end of things in the past.
lines.zh: 不过这大概也只是{i}我自己{/i}的看法。而实际上，过去我可能一直站在完全相反的一端。

lines.en: It’s possible I pressure everyone all the time by just being me.
lines.zh: 有可能我光是做我自己，就时时刻刻在给所有人施压。

lines.en: It’s possible that every single interaction I’ve ever had with someone younger and more naive than me involved me pressuring them in some way because that’s just how these sorts of relationships work.
lines.zh: 有可能我跟每一个比我年轻、比我天真的人的每一次互动，都包含着某种施压，因为这类关系本来就是这么运转的。

lines.en: Being on the other end of that isn’t fun.
lines.zh: 处在那一端并不好受。

lines.en: It’s scary.
lines.zh: 很可怕。

lines.en: And I’d much prefer not being pressured into things anymore.
lines.zh: 而我更希望以后别再被逼着做事。

lines.en: I have been good all day.
lines.zh: 我一整天都很乖。

lines.en: I do not deserve to be punished like this.
lines.zh: 我不该受这种罚。

lines.en: : Arakawa.
lines.zh: : 荒川。

lines.en: scene wakanawalk1
: It is clear that I have overstepped a boundary of yours, and I apologize for that.
lines.zh: : 显然我越过了你的一条界线，为此我道歉。

lines.en: : It wasn’t my intention to trap you into assisting me in what is sure to be another fruitless endeavor. But my endless thirst for all things dark and disturbing drives me to act inappropriately at times.
lines.zh: : 我不是有意把你套进来，让你协助我这场注定又是一无所获的折腾。但我对一切黑暗与不安之物的无尽渴求，有时会让我举止失当。

lines.en: : I have, once again, let that get the better of me and cornered you in a way that I do not feel good about.
lines.zh: : 我又一次被它占了上风，把你逼进了一个我自己也不好受的角落。

lines.en: : Do you ever feel good about {i}anything?{/i}
lines.zh: : 你什么时候对{i}什么事{/i}好受过吗？

lines.en: scene wakanawalk2
: Not really, no. Which likely contributes to my interest in all things black and dreary.
lines.zh: : 基本没有，不。这大概也助长了我对所有黑色和阴沉之物的兴趣。

lines.en: : It is what it is. There’s no need to formally apologize when I never gave you something this professional after literally pushing you up against a wall.
lines.zh: : 就这样吧。毕竟我都把你按在墙上了，却从没给过你这么正式的道歉，你也用不着我道歉。

lines.en: : That is true. But I am a much better person than you are and clearly value this friendship a whole lot more. So please do not hold this apology against me in any form.
lines.zh: : 确实。可我比你高尚得多，而且显然比你看重这段友谊得多。所以请不要以任何形式拿这个道歉来跟我计较。

lines.en: : I will stop pestering you about it for now and attempt to learn more on my own. But there {i}is{/i} one more thing I’d like to say first.
lines.zh: : 我暂时不再纠缠你，会试着自己再查。不过在那之前，我还{i}有{/i}一句话想说。

lines.en: : Me too. And I’d like to say my piece before you say yours.
lines.zh: : 我也是。而且我想在你之前先把我的话说完。

lines.en: scene wakanawalk3
: Feel free.
lines.zh: : 请便。

lines.en: : Stop trying to “learn” more on your own.
lines.zh: : 别再想着自己「查」了。

lines.en: : This whole thing...just give up. It’s probably just some sort of coincidence in the first place.
lines.zh: : 这整件事……算了吧。大概本来就只是某种巧合。

lines.en: : Is that really something you expect me to believe given the reaction you’ve had on multiple occasions now? This is no {i}coincidence,{/i} Arakawa.
lines.zh: : 考虑到你这几次的反应，你真指望我相信这个？这不是{i}巧合{/i}，荒川。

lines.en: : If you want to refuse to divulge information to me, fine. But don’t just outright lie to me. That’s rude.
lines.zh: : 如果你不想把信息告诉我，随你。但别就这么直接对我撒谎。那很失礼。

lines.en: : I just think you’d be happier if you remained ignorant. That’s all.
lines.zh: : 我只是觉得你要是一直不知道，会更幸福。就这样。

lines.en: : Getting involved in another family’s affairs is meaningless when you have your own troubles to worry about.
lines.zh: : 你自己有一堆麻烦要操心的时候，插手别人家的事毫无意义。

lines.en: : I wouldn’t have chosen this line of work if I wanted to remain invested in naught but my own issues. And I would not be wasting my time with {i}you{/i} if that was a factor either.
lines.zh: : 要是我只想关心自己的问题，我就不会选这行了。而且如果那算个因素，我也不会在{i}你{/i}身上浪费时间。

lines.en: scene wakanawalk4
: I’m a gleeful woman, full of joy and rainbows, who simply wants to spread happiness all across the land.
lines.zh: : 我是个快乐的女人，充满喜悦和彩虹，只想把幸福撒满大地。

lines.en: : How hard was that to say on a scale of one to ten?
lines.zh: : 说这句话的难度一到十是几分？

lines.en: scene wakanawalk5
: Fifty. But if straightforward compassion will not reach you, I figured sarcasm might. That’s more your speed, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 五十。不过如果直白的同情到不了你那儿，我想讽刺也许行。那个更合你的节奏，不是吗？

lines.en: : If you want to be {i}compassionate,{/i} stay out of this. For me.
lines.zh: : 如果你真想{i}同情{/i}我，就别插手。为了我。

lines.en: : So you can keep sulking and pretending you don’t love the things I know you do?
lines.zh: : 好让你继续闷着，继续假装你不喜欢那些我知道你喜欢的东西？

lines.en: : So I don’t revert to something even worse.
lines.zh: : 好让我不至于退化成更糟的东西。

lines.en: : It might not seem like it to you, but I’ve made some major strides lately. In a lot of different ways.
lines.zh: : 在你看来也许不像，但我最近迈出了几大步。在很多方面。

lines.en: : But there are things I’m not ready to deal with yet and this is one of them. And I’m sure it’s the same for Ami. So if you really want to be {i}compassionate,{/i} mind your own business. Please.
lines.zh: : 可有些事我还没准备好面对，这就是其中之一。我相信 Ami 也一样。所以如果你真心想{i}同情{/i}，就管好你自己的事。求你了。

lines.en: scene wakanawalk6
: Is that really what you want? To go it alone rather than lean on someone who cares about you?
lines.zh: : 你真想要这样吗？宁可独自扛着，也不靠一个在乎你的人？

lines.en: : You expect me to think you care about me after inviting me out just to satisfy your own curiosity? And then questioning me about a thing you {i}know{/i} sets me off?
lines.zh: : 你请我出来只为满足你自己的好奇心，然后又拿一件你{i}知道{/i}会让我炸的事来盘问我——你还指望我觉得你是在乎我？

lines.en: scene wakanawalk7
: That might have been how it seemed, but-
lines.zh: : 看起来也许是那样，可——

lines.en: : I was actually looking forward to hanging out with you without there being some ulterior motive for once. Then this happened. But I guess that’s on me for agreeing to come in the first place.
lines.zh: : 我其实是盼着能有一次不带别的目的、单纯跟你玩。然后就出了这事。不过既然我当初答应来了，这也怪我。

lines.en: : Arakawa-
lines.zh: : 荒川——

lines.en: : What did {i}you{/i} want to say? Sorry for interrupting. Mine took a little longer than I thought it would.
lines.zh: : {i}你{/i}想说什么？抱歉打断你了。我这段说得比我想的长。

lines.en: scene wakanawalk8
: Do you know why I wanted you to write something for the contest? And why I was so furious when you didn’t?
lines.zh: : 你知道我为什么想让你为比赛写点东西吗？又为什么在你没写时那么生气？

lines.en: : Because poetry turns you on.
lines.zh: : 因为诗能让你发情。

lines.en: : No, you fucking imbecile. It’s because I have to see your disgusting, expressionless face every single day while knowing {i}damn{/i} well that you are suppressing something and making yourself even uglier.
lines.zh: : 不是，你这操蛋的白痴。是因为我每天都得看着你那张恶心的、毫无表情的脸，同时{i}清清楚楚{/i}地知道你在压抑着什么，把自己弄得更丑。

lines.en: scene wakanawalk9

: Even if you don’t share it with anyone, writing can help you with your feelings. You can let them out without dragging anyone else down in the process. And that’s something you’re afraid of, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 就算你不跟任何人分享，写作也能帮你处理情绪。你可以把它们放出来，而不在这个过程中把别人拖下水。而你怕的就是这个，不是吗？

lines.en: : Have you stopped to think that maybe I just don’t like writing anymore?
lines.zh: : 你有没有想过，也许我就是不再喜欢写作了？

lines.en: : No, because that’s stupid and you’re lying when you say that.
lines.zh: : 没有，因为那很蠢，而你说这话的时候在撒谎。

lines.en: : I’m proud that you’re allegedly making these alleged {i}strides{/i} and that you’re allegedly not as bad as you allegedly used to be. But if you want to make a {i}real{/i} stride...{i}write.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我为你「据称」迈出了这些「据称」的{i}进步{/i}、为你「据称」不像从前那么糟而感到骄傲。但如果你想迈出{i}真正{/i}的一步……{i}写吧{/i}。

lines.en: : That’s all I wanted to tell you before we drop this altogether.
lines.zh: : 在我们彻底搁下这件事之前，我想说的就是这些。

lines.en: : I’ll think about it, Wakana. But I’m kind of mad at you right now.
lines.zh: : 我会考虑的，Wakana。不过我现在有点生你的气。

lines.en: scene wakanawalk10
: {i}Hah...{/i}again, I apologize. You’re not the only one who struggles to properly convey their thoughts and feelings, you know.
lines.zh: : {i}哈……{/i}再说一次，对不起。你知道，不只是你一个人没法好好表达自己的想法和感受。

lines.en: : Yes. I may despise every fiber of your being. But it’s not as if I actually {i}dislike{/i} you.
lines.zh: : 是。我也许厌恶你身上的每一根纤维。但我并不是真的{i}讨厌{/i}你。

lines.en: : Wow, you really are bad at conveying your thoughts and feelings if {i}that{/i} is the pitch you’re going to use to highlight our apparent friendship.
lines.zh: : 哇，如果你打算用{i}这句话{/i}来突出我们这所谓的友谊，那你表达想法和感受的能力是真差。

lines.en: : Arakawa, I despise every fiber of {i}every{/i} person’s being. And I wish humanity as a whole would just fall into a sinkhole and die sometimes.
lines.zh: : 荒川，我厌恶{i}每一个{/i}人身上的每一根纤维。我有时希望人类作为一个整体掉进天坑里死掉。

lines.en: : Don’t wish for that too hard or it might just happen again.
lines.zh: : 别许愿许得太用力，不然它可能真的会再发生一次。

lines.en: : Sometimes I believe that my constant wishing for that is why it happened to our rival school in the first place. But that is beside the point.
lines.zh: : 我有时觉得，正是我不停地这么许愿，我们的对手学校才出了那事。不过这不是重点。

lines.en: : Yes, I hate everyone. And {i}everyone{/i} includes you.
lines.zh: : 对，我恨所有人。而{i}所有人{/i}里包括你。

lines.en: scene wakanawalk11
: But I am glad you are a part of my life. And the reason I’m so hard on you all the time is because I know you can be so much more than you are now. You just {i}won’t.{/i} And that pisses me off.
lines.zh: : 但我很高兴你是我生命的一部分。而我总是对你这么苛刻，是因为我知道你能比现在的你强得多。只是你{i}不肯{/i}。而这让我火大。

lines.en: : Again, I’m trying to get better. It’s just taking a really long time.
lines.zh: : 再说一次，我在努力变好。只是花的时间真的很久。

lines.en: : Well, there will always be an option there to speed it up should your backbone ever regrow.
lines.zh: : 嗯，等你的脊梁哪天重新长出来，总还有个选项能加速这件事。

lines.en: : I’ll keep that in mind. Thanks.
lines.zh: : 我记下了。谢了。

lines.en: scene wakanawalk12
: Fine. I suppose that’s all I can ask for.
lines.zh: : 行。我想我只能要求到这儿了。

lines.en: : I’m still mad at you, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我还是在生你的气。

lines.en: : Are you ten years old?
lines.zh: : 你十岁吗？

lines.en: : No. Just betrayed.
lines.zh: : 不是。只是觉得被背叛了。

lines.en: : Would carrying me around help you feel better?
lines.zh: : 那背着你会不会让你好受点？

lines.en: : I can’t imagine it would, Wakana.
lines.zh: : 我想不会，Wakana。

lines.en: : Are you absolutely sure?
lines.zh: : 你确定？

lines.en: : I am absolutely sure, yes.
lines.zh: : 我很确定，是的。

lines.en: scene wakanawalk13
: You’re {i}positive?{/i}
lines.zh: : 你{i}肯定{/i}？

lines.en: : I’m positive.
lines.zh: : 我肯定。

lines.en: : There’s not a question in your mind?
lines.zh: : 你心里一点疑问都没有？
: 百分之百？

lines.en: : Wakana, what is this?
lines.zh: : Wakana，你这是要干嘛？

lines.en: scene wakanawalk14
: Arakawa, I’m well aware this is probably the worst possible time for this, but I need you to carry me.
lines.zh: : 荒川，我很清楚现在大概是最糟糕的时机，但我需要你背我。

lines.en: : Excuse me?
lines.zh: : 你说什么？

lines.en: : It’s a long story. But I’m in excruciating pain right now and I am probably going to collapse if we keep walking.
lines.zh: : 说来话长。但我现在疼得要命，要是继续走我大概会倒下。

lines.en: : Did you really try to trick me into thinking I {i}wanted{/i} to do this instead of just asking?
lines.zh: : 你真的想让我以为是我自己{i}想{/i}背你，而不是直接开口问？

lines.en: scene wakanawalk15
: Yes. Because ideally, you would have agreed and I wouldn’t have had to explain myself. It would have looked like me giving you a reward.
lines.zh: : 是的。因为理想情况下，你会答应，我就不用解释了。那样看起来就像我在给你一个奖励。

lines.en: : You really can’t walk?
lines.zh: : 你真的走不了？

lines.en: : I can not. And in a perfect world, I’d have pills with me to help for cases like this. But I have proven to be irresponsible with them and will no longer carry them when I don’t expect to be going places.
lines.zh: : 走不了。而且在完美世界里，我会随身带着药以防这种情况。但我证明过自己对它们不负责，所以在不打算出门时就不再带了。

lines.en: : I guess that’s something you should have thought about before inviting me miles away from school and then proceeding to make me mad.
lines.zh: : 我想你把我约到离学校这么远的地方、然后还把我惹毛之前，本该想到这一点的。

lines.en: : As fun and peppy as your grumpy side can be, Arakawa- my legs are starting to shake and you are an able-bodied man who has recently proven to have a great deal of stamina.
lines.zh: : 你生气别扭的样子再怎么有趣可爱，荒川——我的腿已经开始抖了，而你是个四肢健全的男人，最近还证明了耐力惊人。

lines.en: : I’m never going to let you live this down, you know.
lines.zh: : 我这辈子都不会让你忘记这事的，你知道吧。

lines.en: : Oh, I’m well aware of that. But the alternative in this case is lying on the sidewalk until Osako can come pick me up.
lines.zh: : 哦，我清楚得很。但在这个情况下，另一个选项是躺在人行道上等 Osako 来接我。

lines.en: : There’s {i}no{/i} other option?
lines.zh: : {i}没有{/i}别的办法了？

lines.en: : There’s no other option.
lines.zh: : 没有别的办法了。

lines.en: : Buy me dinner.
lines.zh: : 请我吃晚饭。

lines.en: : Deal.
lines.zh: : 成交。

lines.en: scene black
scene wakanawalk16
It’s a lot harder to be mad at someone with their legs wrapped around you and their chin resting on your shoulder. I learned that today.
lines.zh: 要让一个双腿缠着你、下巴搁在你肩上的人继续对你生气，是很难的。我今天学到了。

lines.en: It’s actually {i}easier{/i} to be mad at someone while you’re having sex with them than this. This is just...uncomfortable.
lines.zh: 说真的，跟一个人上着床生气，都比这样{i}容易{/i}。这样只是……不舒服。

lines.en: But strangely enough, it doesn’t seem that way for Wakana.
lines.zh: 但奇怪的是，对 Wakana 来说似乎并不是这样。

lines.en: Which tricks me into believing, once again, that maybe she does value me. And maybe she {i}wasn’t{/i} just trying to use me for her own benefit today.
lines.zh: 这又一次骗我相信，也许她真的重视我。也许她今天{i}不是{/i}只想利用我。

lines.en: But I have a hard time believing that when it comes to people who aren’t naive. And Wakana is anything but.
lines.zh: 但当对方不是天真的人时，我很难相信这个。而 Wakana 绝不天真。

lines.en: I {i}know{/i} she sees through me. And I feel that, at often times, I {i}let{/i} her because I {i}want{/i} her to realize how broken I am.
lines.zh: 我{i}知道{/i}她看穿了我。而且我常常觉得我{i}让{/i}她看穿，是因为我{i}想{/i}让她意识到我有多破碎。

lines.en: But then she does...and I don’t like it. So I backtrack and try to make things normal again, only to realize that it’s far too late.
lines.zh: 可她真的看穿了……我又不喜欢。于是我往回缩，试图把一切装回正常，然后才发现已经太迟了。

lines.en: And now here she is...defenseless and just inches away from my face. But I have no desire to walk her down a dark alley and seize the day.
lines.zh: 而现在她就在这儿……毫无防备，离我的脸只有几英寸。但我一点都不想把她拖进黑巷子、及时行乐。

lines.en: Instead...I just want to look at her.
lines.zh: 相反……我只想看着她。

lines.en: To peer into the eyes of someone who doesn’t care for my shiny coat of paint or my polychromatic mask.
lines.zh: 去凝视一双不在乎我那层亮漆、也不在乎我那张彩色面具的眼睛。

lines.en: And to get lost in {i}her{/i} when I know with all of my decaying heart that I shouldn’t.
lines.zh: 并在我那颗正在腐烂的心清楚知道不该如此的时候，迷失在{i}她{/i}里面。

lines.en: : Is this weird for you?
lines.zh: : 这样对你来说很怪吧？

lines.en: : A little. But I’ve gotten used to it over the years.
lines.zh: : 有一点。但这些年我已经习惯了。

lines.en: : Is this a common occurrence for you or was that more sarcasm?
lines.zh: : 这种情况对你来说很常见，还是刚才那句也是讽刺？

lines.en: : It’s a relatively common occurrence, unfortunately. But modern medicine has made it mostly manageable. And my partner can carry me across all of Japan without so much as breaking a sweat.
lines.zh: : 不幸的是，算比较常见。但现代医学让它大体可控。而且我的伴侣能背着我走遍全日本都不带流一滴汗。

lines.en: : It’s really only an issue when I find myself miles from home with strange men. Which, needless to say, has happened a grand total of one time in recent memory.
lines.zh: : 真正成为问题的，是我发现自己离家几英里远、还跟陌生男人在一起的时候。不用说，这种事最近总共只发生过一次。

lines.en: : Is this, like...the result of some kind of accident or something? Or were you just born weak?
lines.zh: : 这是……某种意外的结果？还是你天生就虚弱？

lines.en: scene wakanawalk17
: I suppose it would be a little bit of both.
lines.zh: : 我想两者都有点。

lines.en: : It’s not a very interesting story, but I believe I owe you at least {i}some{/i} amount of uninhibited chatter on account of how unmistakably {i}unfriendly{/i} I’ve been today.
lines.zh: : 这不是什么有趣的故事，不过鉴于我今天明显{i}不太友好{/i}，我觉得我至少欠你{i}一些{/i}无所顾忌的闲聊。

lines.en: : That was a lot of “uns” for one sentence.
lines.zh: : 一句话里「不」字也太多了。

lines.en: scene wakanawalk18
: Do you want to hear why I’m making you do this or not?
lines.zh: : 你到底想不想知道我为什么让你干这个？

lines.en: : My bad. Go ahead.
lines.zh: : 我的错。请讲。

lines.en: : Okay. But again, it’s not very interesting.
lines.zh: : 好。不过再说一次，这不太有趣。

lines.en: : Then maybe I don’t want to hear it after all.
lines.zh: : 那也许我还是不想听了。

lines.en: : Well, too bad because here it comes.
lines.zh: : 唉，太糟了，因为它来了。

lines.en: scene wakanawalk19
: I was born well before I was meant to be — which resulted in a slew of health issues that I’ve been dealing with for my entire life. Some more severe than others.
lines.zh: : 我出生得比预产期早了很久——这导致了一连串健康问题，我这一辈子都在跟它们打交道。有些比另一些严重。

lines.en: : Among those issues was the malformation of my spine.
lines.zh: : 其中之一是我的脊椎畸形。

lines.en: : Thankfully, I was born to a wealthy family that was able to afford the corrective surgery needed to repair it.
lines.zh: : 幸运的是，我出生在一个富裕家庭，付得起修复它所需的矫正手术。

lines.en: : {i}Un{/i}thankfully, even the most experienced of surgeons in the most prestigious of hospitals can’t help but make mistakes sometimes. They’re human, after all. That sort of thing is inevitable.
lines.zh: : {i}不{/i}幸的是，即便是最有声望的医院里最有经验的外科医生，有时也免不了犯错。他们毕竟是人。这种事不可避免。

lines.en: : I’m sure I don’t have to tell you this, but the spine is a fragile thing. One wrong move or injury to that part of the body could leave you paralyzed for life. So I’m lucky I got off with just this.
lines.zh: : 我想不用我告诉你，脊椎是个脆弱的东西。那个部位一次失误或损伤就能让你终身瘫痪。所以只落得现在这样，我已经算走运。

lines.en: : I was {i}not{/i} lucky enough to be gifted an entirely {i}normal{/i} life, though — and I’ve been mildly useless in all things physical ever since.
lines.zh: : 但我{i}没{/i}走运到被赐予一个完全{i}正常{/i}的人生——从那以后，我在一切体力事上都轻度无用。

lines.en: scene wakanawalk20
: Well...{i}almost{/i} all things. I still excel in a few...{i}select{/i} areas.
lines.zh: : 嗯……{i}几乎{/i}所有事。我在少数……{i}特定{/i}领域依然出色。

lines.en: : I’m happy for Osako.
lines.zh: : 我替 Osako 高兴。

lines.en: scene wakanawalk21
: As you should be. But there are a few more {i}appropriate{/i} areas I was able to manage in as well. Like kyudo.
lines.zh: : 你该如此。不过还有几个更{i}得体{/i}的领域我也还应付得来。比如弓道。

lines.en: : Isn’t that really taxing on a person’s back, though?
lines.zh: : 可那不是很伤背吗？

lines.en: : Very. And when I was going to Higashigaoka, my doctors advised that I pursue something else instead at the risk of further harming myself.
lines.zh: : 非常伤。我在东丘上学的时候，医生建议我改做别的，否则有进一步伤到自己的风险。

lines.en: : But you disregarded their opinions and kept doing kyudo anyway?
lines.zh: : 可你无视了他们的意见，还是继续练弓道？

lines.en: : Yes. But also no. I was never able to compete in tournaments, but I could still shoot two days out of the week. But that was enough for me back then.
lines.zh: : 是，也不是。我从没能参加比赛，但一周还是能射两天。那时候对我来说这就够了。

lines.en: : And {i}more{/i} than enough for me {i}now{/i} to become the instructor of a bunch of public school girls without any experience. And also Ushibori, who is just...very good, for some reason.
lines.zh: : 而{i}现在{/i}，这{i}更{/i}足够让我当上一群毫无经验的公立学校女生的指导了。还有牛堀，她就是……很厉害，不知为什么。

lines.en: : She’s from Nara. They're probably more interested in boring stuff like archery out there.
lines.zh: : 她来自奈良。那边的人大概对射箭这种无聊的东西更感兴趣。

lines.en: : That explains a few things. Also, fuck you.
lines.zh: : 这解释了几件事。还有，操你的。

lines.en: : What other health issues do you have as a result of your...early birth thing? You said there were more, right?
lines.zh: : 因为那个……早产的毛病，你还有别的什么健康问题？你说过还有，对吧？

lines.en: : A few. But I think one is enough for today. It’s not as if hearing any of the others will assist in explaining why I’m making you carry me.
lines.zh: : 有几个。但我觉得今天一个就够了。反正听别的也解释不了我为什么让你背我。

lines.en: : Is your back okay in that position? Do I need to, like...adjust you or anything?
lines.zh: : 你那个姿势背还行吗？需要我……调整你一下什么的？

lines.en: : This is plenty, Arakawa. Thank you.
lines.zh: : 这样就很好，荒川。谢谢。

lines.en: : Don’t worry about it. You could have just told me this earlier instead of trying to trick me into carrying you, though.
lines.zh: : 别客气。不过你早说就行了，不用骗我背你。

lines.en: : Excuse me, are {i}you{/i} telling {i}me{/i} to be more open about my insecurities and the things that hold me back in life?
lines.zh: : 打扰一下，{i}你{/i}是在叫{i}我{/i}对我自己的不安、对那些在人生中拖我后腿的东西更坦白吗？

lines.en: : Touché.
lines.zh: : 说得好。

lines.en: : Touché indeed.
lines.zh: : 确实说得好。

lines.en: scene wakanawalk22
: I wonder what Osako would say if she saw us like this.
lines.zh: : 我好奇 Osako 要是看到我们这样会说什么。

lines.en: scene black
: Don’t.
$ wakanadate25p2 = True
$ wakana_love += 1
{i}Wakana’s affection has increased to [wakana_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Wakana 的好感度提升到了 [wakana_love]!{/i}
